You smile and feint toward one side, then strike from the other and step away as your opponent turns after you.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One adjacent creature.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Use a melee weapon, a wink and a deliberately misleading step.

Weak
3 physical damage.
Standard
3 physical damage; move 1 square without provoking.
Strong
5 physical damage; move 2 squares without provoking.
